title: Carolina Collection 30-Inch Wall Mount Towel Bar In Solid Brass | Oil Rubbed Bronze | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop piling towels on the vanity and give your bathroom a dedicated, easy-to-reach place to hang them in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. This Carolina Collection towel bar brings traditional, timeless styling to classic bath accessories while keeping your space organized.

  • Oil Rubbed Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Coordinates with other Carolina pieces for a distinguished, heritage-inspired look
  • Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Save space in the bathroom with a wall-mounted design that keeps towels off counters and shelves.

Specs & Installation

  • Product type: towel bar
  • Collection: Carolina Collection
  • Overall size: 30 in L x 2 in D x 3.5 in H
  • Weight: 3.2 lbs
  • Material: solid brass
  • Mounting: wall mount; concealed screw mounting hardware included
  • multiple designer finish options available
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
